carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant longitudinal ridge is present on the upper lateral flank, defined by a high-contrast horizontal edge with peak luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 18 high-luminance blobs are distributed within the first dorsal fin silhouette. Spot density is non-uniform, with higher clusters observed along the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A linear, reddish-brown pigment anomaly is visible posterior to the gill region and superior to the pectoral fin base. A slight notch-like irregularity is present on the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
